figurative_meaning_bn: সবকাজের কাজি; সব ব্যাপারে যে উপস্থিত
figurative_meaning_en: The overseer of all tasks; someone present or involved in every matter
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামের সব অনুষ্ঠানে সে উপস্থিত থাকে, একেবারে হলুদ গুঁড়োর মতো।
অফিসের সব ঝগড়ায় সে মাথা গলায়, সত্যিই হলুদ গুঁড়ো।
example_sentences_in_english: He is present at every village event, just like turmeric powder.
She pokes her nose into every office quarrel, truly a busybody.
history: This idiom draws from the everyday use of turmeric powder in Bengali households for cooking, rituals, and medicine, symbolizing something essential and omnipresent in all affairs.
note: The idiom highlights the indispensable yet pervasive nature of turmeric in Bengali culture, extending metaphorically to people who insert themselves everywhere.
